author: National Geographic
description:
What secrets are still hidden in ancient Egypt? In this Lost Treasures of Egypt MEGA Episode, National Geographic follows archaeologists seeking answers to Egypt’s most enduring mysteries, from the riddles of the Great Sphinx and the rise of the pyramids to megatombs and forgotten burial sites. Through new excavations, rare discoveries, and cutting-edge archaeology, experts search for clues about ancient Egyptian gods, pharaohs, tomb builders, mummies, and the lost chapters of Egypt’s history. 

Featuring three full episodes:

Mysteries of the Sphinx - 00:00 
Delving into one of the most enduring mysteries of ancient Egypt, this episode follows archaeologists on a mission to unravel the riddles of the Great Sphinx. Our field teams make incredible discoveries of abandoned sphinx statues and rare mummified animals, while experts search for clues to explain the role of animal gods in ancient Egypt, including the lion-bodied Sphinx of Giza.
